provides.name: Validator extension — fourth `issue` doc-type category
provides.description: Adds ISSUE_DOC_TYPES, ISSUE_STATES, ISSUE_PER_STATE_REQUIRED_FIELDS module-level constants and a validate_issue_artifact function to .claude/skills/auditing-shared/scripts/validate_pipeline_frontmatter.py. Adds a new elif branch inside validate_pipeline_artifact dispatching on doc_type in ISSUE_DOC_TYPES. Outer dispatch at lines 365-371 unchanged.

provides.name: Regression-test fixture set for the new branch
provides.description: L3 + L4 synthetic and post-migration fixtures under .claude/skills/auditing-shared/scripts/test_fixtures/issue_doc_types/ — at minimum 18 (doc_type × state) positive cases, 6 missing-companion-field negative cases, 3 invalid-status negative cases, and 4 post-FR-8-migration fixtures.

provides.name: Regression-corpus baseline-capture procedure
provides.description: Documented pre/post baseline-capture procedure (§7 of backend-design.md): capture findings JSON pre-extension against L1+L2 corpus; implement extension; capture post-extension findings JSON; diff must be empty. Baseline captured PRE-implementation per synthesis D-10.

depends_on.what: Final lock on three new doc_type enum strings
depends_on.why_blocks_backend: These strings populate ISSUE_DOC_TYPES. Renaming after Backend implementation would require a coordinated change across the validator, templates, agent body, and the FR-8 migration back-fill.

These strings populate ISSUE_STATES. The vocabulary is named in the PRD and synthesis and confirmed at Intent Clarification, but `design-cc` formally owns the lifecycle design (synthesis D-05 shared routing).
These strings populate ISSUE_PER_STATE_REQUIRED_FIELDS. The validator enforces presence; the field names must match the templates (FR-6) authored by design-cc.
depends_on.note: Values shown are the synthesis-D-05-recommended slate; final lock owned by design-cc.

depends_on.what: Optional cross-link field names and their ID-syntax pattern
depends_on.why_blocks_backend: These drive the syntactic-correctness check inside validate_issue_artifact. A canonical regex for ID syntax is also needed.
depends_on.note: Validator can ship without this check and add it in a follow-up; not on the critical path for AC-FR-7-a/b/c/d.

depends_on.what: Confirmation that `proposes_future_feature` field-name string remains as-is
depends_on.why_blocks_backend: Drives the D-06 advisory check on issue-proposal. Two existing precedents (F-006) use this literal field name.
depends_on.note: If design-cc renames the field in the new templates, the validator's advisory check must match the new name.

depends_on.why_blocks_backend: Informational dependency. The validator only inspects frontmatter, not body shape. The dependency exists because the templates' frontmatter sections must declare the fields this validator enforces.

depends_on.what: FR-8 migration back-fill values (doc_type rename + status:open + since:<date> + version:0.1.0) on the 4 pre-migration files
depends_on.why_blocks_backend: The L4 regression-corpus layer (§7 of backend-design.md) requires the 4 migrated files in their post-back-fill state. AC-FR-8-c (validator-clean on the 4 migrated files) and AC-FR-7-a both depend on the back-fill matching the validator's expectations.
depends_on.note: Plan-author sequences the FR-7 implementation and FR-8 migration; the validator can be extended first, then the migration runs against the extended validator.

cross_layer.resolution_path: design-cc finalizes the field-name strings (BE-DEP-3); design-backend codifies them into ISSUE_PER_STATE_REQUIRED_FIELDS in the validator. Composer arbitrates if naming conflicts arise.

cross_layer.decision: D-10 (validator extension shape — doc_type enum values)
cross_layer.resolution_path: design-cc owns the canonical enum strings (BE-DEP-1); design-backend uses them verbatim. Q-BE-1 surfaces the recommendation for composer arbitration.

provides_to_plan.name: Plan-step: capture regression-corpus baseline BEFORE implementing extension
provides_to_plan.rationale: Per synthesis D-10, NFR-8 verification requires the pre-extension findings JSON as the diff baseline. Plan must sequence: (1) extend smoke_test_auditing_shared.py with the regression runner; (2) run validator pre-extension; persist baseline; (3) implement extension; (4) run validator post-extension; (5) diff; (6) assert empty diff.

provides_to_plan.name: Plan-step: extend smoke_test_auditing_shared.py with regression_test_issue_extension()
provides_to_plan.rationale: Per CP-006, smoke_test_auditing_shared.py is the canonical test surface for the validator. Plan-author owns the harness-wiring choice (extend in place vs sibling file).

provides_to_tests.name: Regression-corpus assertion: pre/post diff must be empty
provides_to_tests.rationale: NFR-8 acceptance: post-extension validator findings byte-identical to pre-extension findings on the L1+L2 corpus.
provides_to_tests.ears_form: When the post-extension validator is run against the regression corpus, the system shall produce findings byte-identical to the pre-extension baseline.

provides_to_tests.name: Per-state positive and negative fixtures
provides_to_tests.rationale: L3 fixtures: 18 positive (doc_type × state) cases + 6 missing-field negatives + 3 invalid-status negatives — these are the acceptance fixtures for AC-BE-1..AC-BE-5.

open_questions_for_composer: Q-BE-1 — Final lock on three new doc_type enum strings (issue-register / issue-analysis / issue-proposal). Recommended: PRD-named slate.
Q-BE-2 — Final field-name slate for per-state required companions. Recommended: synthesis D-05 slate verbatim.
Q-BE-3 — Should superseded_by_issue_id share namespace with ADR-0005's superseded_by? Recommended: distinct field name.
Q-BE-4 — Single PR vs split PRs for the extension? Recommended: single PR with synthesis-D-10 baseline-capture procedure.
Q-BE-5 — Regression corpus L2 storage: checked-in fixtures, path references, or findings-only snapshot? Recommended: findings-only snapshot.

constraints_honored.how: Option A (§3 of backend-design.md) adds only an elif branch dispatching on doc_type in ISSUE_DOC_TYPES; no existing branch modified. Empirical verification via the regression-corpus diff (§7).

No ADR authored by this design. Architectural decisions surfaced as Q-BE-1..Q-BE-5 in §16 of backend-design.md.
